0.0: The memory you lost... The memory of those innocent days when you were just a new adventurer learning the ropes. If you want to restore those memories, you have no choice but to return to that time...

yes.0: Go back to the starting point when your adventures began. The place where everything was new and fascinating, where you were filled with curiosity, excitement, and anticipation...

no.0: Don't underestimate the power of a memory. You are who you are today because of the memories you have...

1.0: You are now filled with all of your memories again..

default.0: Return to the point when you began your adventure... when everything was unfamiliar and amazing... when you were full of expectations and hopes...

QuestInfo.name: [Temple of Time] Memory Keeper
QuestInfo.1: You went to see #p2140001#, just as #p2140000# told you. He knew that you had lost your memory. To retrieve it, you need to go back to where your adventure began...
QuestInfo.2: After talking to the Memory Keeper, I went to my previous job post at Victoria Island to retrieve my memory.  I wonder if it worked.  I guess I'll know when I try to go past Memory Lane.
